synopsis: In the aftermath of Tempest Keep, Kael'thas tests the value of his prize at the Sunfury staging grounds by ordering his followers to siphon from M'uru in turn, proving that the captive naaru can feed them without meaningful depletion and prompting the first serious discussion of whether its power might allow Quel'Thalas to forge a new kind of holy warrior. From there the return to Quel'Thalas is swift, secretive, and secondary to what awaits at home: once M'uru is concealed within Silvermoon, the meaning of the Outland mission shifts from military triumph to containment, governance, and use. Reunited with Theron and Lethira, Falanaras watches Lor'themar and the kingdom's leaders confront the practical and political consequences of what Kael'thas's servants have delivered, while the city absorbs this new source of power much as it has absorbed other harsh necessities of survival. Rommath, Astalor, and Liadrin each interpret the captive Light differently, and Liadrin's harder understanding begins to take root in Falanaras as his old friends recognize how much Outland has changed him.
title: Chapter 10: Return to Silvermoon
